ABOUT US

People who power purpose

We are on a mission to build software that defines the next generation of emergency response technology.

View open positionsView our founding story

How we work

We move with intention

Our team works fast, thinks clearly, and stays focused on what matters: developing purpose-built technology for Public Safety Answering Points (PSAPs) to better support their communities. We build, refine, and ship with a level of intensity and care that comes from knowing our work has real impact. It’s straightforward: we do the work, we do it well, and we do it quickly.

Purpose-led, people-first

The team behind your experience

Meet our team who make it happen

Sandra Skvarkova

Head of Talent

Hiring at Aurelian is such a special experience because we get to build a team of people who are not only incredibly talented, but who are also the very best at what they do, and who fall in love with what we’re building, just like we all did.

Noah Smith

Software Engineer

It's energizing to build technology that supports telecommunicators doing meaningful work, especially when you can directly see the positive impact on their day-to-day.

Cate Ralph

Marketing Manager

It’s inspiring to work with people who are driven to produce real results for the people they build products for, and it’s my job to make sure that impact is not only widely seen, but also deeply understood.

Frank Pavey

Implementation Specialist

Coming from the call-taker side––having used the product in a center that implemented it––I saw firsthand how it reduced noise, handled the small stuff, and gave call-takers more time and focus for emergencies.

Daniel Khain

Senior Software Engineer

I love working on challenging problems, and it's incredibly rewarding to build new products that help dispatchers and call-takers better serve their communities.

Our values

What truly matters to us

Care deeply

We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and  the impact of our work.

Deliver Results

We own outcomes, not just tasks, and follow through on what we start.

Bias for Action

We emphasize initiative in identifying problems and advancing solutions.

Speed over perfection

We focus on progress, ship early, and iterate continuously.

Respect Time

We respect the weight of every call and build tools that honor the time of the people answering them.

Day to day

Our culture

We build together, support one another, and celebrate our shared wins.

Where it started

Founders

Before founding Aurelian, Max and James were building call automation technology for hair salons. Their perspective changed when one customer spent  45-minutes waiting on a city’s non-emergency line, handled by the same call-takers responsible for answering 911 calls.

Max Keenan

CEO

James Liu

CTO

That insight led them to pivot to Public Safety and build for PSAPs to help telecommunicators handle non-emergency demand more efficiently, reduce cognitive load, and help call-takers stay focused on emergencies.
